measured.inference: one unpadded forward pass per headline

rationale: reference_ic = IC of the served int8 model on the frozen fixture at the time the gate was set.

Fixture and model are frozen, so IC can only move through numerics. Numerics-only changes measured on this fixture moved IC by up to 0.004 (int8 scheme choice; padded batching vs single passes). x86 int8 kernels (Cloud Run, GitHub runners) differ from ARM ones. A 0.005 margin avoids false failures from the CPU alone.

One standard error of a 58-day mean IC is about 0.026, so the IC check alone cannot catch small regressions, and with a negative reference IC it cannot catch a sign flip. The agreement check against the frozen fp32 scores (CPU-independent: they match torch to 1e-5) catches label-order, tokenizer and quantization regressions. Its thresholds are about 2x the measured int8 error; per-tensor int8 (mean diff 0.050) would fail it.
